summary: Frontend UI verification of 2 P0 bug fixes reported by the Italian user. BOTH BUGS VERIFIED FIXED. (1) Contact detail back button (testID back-btn) at /contact/[id]: correctly navigates back to /contatti when history exists AND correctly falls back to router.replace('/(tabs)/contatti') when deep-linked. (2) Calendar Month view layout refactor (FlatList → ScrollView): area filter row (testID cal-area-filters) stays visible above the month grid at y=108,h=44 and does NOT move on scroll (scrollTop=400 → filter y unchanged at 108). Month grid renders all 31 days of Aug 2026 in a 5-week layout inside cal-scroll (testID). Date header 'Sabato 15 Agosto' + event card 'Demo prodotti Artistry' render below the grid and are fully visible. No content is cut off. Week view (view-week) and Year view (view-year) tested — no regression (12 year month-cells; week days render; filter row visible in every view). Tapping day 15 in Month view correctly selects it and displays that day's events. Pre-existing 'Unexpected text node' warnings (P1) still present but not blockers per request.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' warnings still appear ~12 times in console after login. Unchanged from iteration 19. Not related to the 2 P0 bugs tested here. Reference: home.tsx / contact/[id].tsx (previous iterations).
'shadow*' style props are deprecated; use 'boxShadow'. Pre-existing warning, unchanged.

action_items: OPTIONAL (P1, pre-existing): track down and remove the stray whitespace text nodes that trigger 'Unexpected text node' warnings on the Home screen and elsewhere (not a blocker for the current bugs).

calendario.tsx line 143-151: cal-area-filters ScrollView has maxHeight:44 in inline style — good, keeps chips from stretching (was the design-issue callout in iteration 19).

calendario.tsx line 192-281: viewMode !== 'year' branch wraps MonthGrid + dateHeader + event cards in a single ScrollView (cal-scroll) with paddingBottom:60 so nothing is cut. Correct refactor from FlatList.
